issues.title: [Bug]: Polymorph mixin causes crashes when interacting with current JEI version

labels.name: status: confirmed
labels.description: This issue or pull request has been accepted

issues.body:
### Minecraft Version

1.19.2

### What happened?

As far as I can tell, a recent group of JEI (Just Enough Items) update has removed the class IRecipeLayoutInternal or a bridge Polymorph could use to access it. 

When Polymorph’s current version and JEI’s recent versions are in a modpack together, clicking on an item in JEI’s menu to see its recipe instantly crashes the game. I made a bug report to the JEI developer and they confirmed the problem was from Polymorph, not JEI.

Downgrading from JEI 10.6.1.1023 to 10.2.1.1010 fixed the problem, so is after that when the problem occurs.

Attached is the bug report, and both mod packs I am on had the issue occur. You can see the packs in the JEI report I made on this site. Both packs have polymorph and the problem began once I updated their JEI versions.

### How do you trigger this bug?

1. Join a world like normal
2. Open your inventory page in either creative or survival
3. Go to the right of the inventory and click any block in the JEI menu (both vanilla or modded)
4. Minecraft instantly saves the world and crashes.
...

Forge

### Loader Version

Forge - 40.3.12

### API Version

N/A

labels.name: status: triage

issues.body:
### Minecraft Version

1.20.1

### What happened?

Hello,

When multiple crafting recipes are available for the same item (a core feature of Polymorph), the button that allows recipe selection becomes difficult to use. You either have to click multiple times, or click a very specific pixel on the button for the recipe selection menu to appear.

This makes the feature unreliable and frustrating to use, especially during fast-paced gameplay or with many available recipes.

✅ Steps to Reproduce:
1. Have two or more valid recipes for the same item (e.g., from different mods).
2. Attempt to click the Polymorph button in the crafting interface.
3. Observe that:
3.1 Nothing happens on most clicks.
3.2 You must click repeatedly.
3.3 Only a tiny, precise spot on the button is actually responsive.

📦 Environment:
* Minecraft Version: 1.20.1
* Polymorph Version: v0.49.10+1.20.1
* Other Mods Installed:
  * Better End
  * Better Nether
  * BCLib
* Mod Loader: Fabric v0.16.13

Thank you so much in advance.

2. Attempt to click the Polymorph button in the crafting interface.

labels.name: status: confirmed
labels.description: This issue or pull request has been accepted

issues.body:
### Minecraft Version

1.20.1

### What happened?

Randomly at startup of a map we get a NullPointerException while going through the capabilities of items. The bug appear at fairly random times sometimes weeks can go without it triggering. But every time it triggers we have a NullPointerException on polymorph.
After the bug triggers the game crashes and on reload of the same map all tile entities are now reset, so any custom data inside disappear.

### How do you trigger this bug?

Since the bug appears randomly we have not found a way to reproduce it systematically... But at some point in the execution the content of `PolymorphCommon.blockEntity2RecipeData` contains a null element that trigger the NPE while `PolymorphCommon.tryCreateRecipeData` is running resulting in an issue with all following block entities.

issues.body:
### Minecraft Version

1.20.1

### What happened?

Hi there,

I've been experiencing some crashes while playing Minecraft with the Polymorph mod installed. The crash seems to be occurring when the game is rendering the screen.

Here are the important details from the crash report:


java.lang.NullPointerException: Cannot invoke "net.minecraft.class_1735.method_7681()" because "containerScreen.field_2787" is null
    at net.minecraft.class_332.handler$hjc000$equipmentcompare$renderTooltip(class_332.java:6342)
    at net.minecraft.class_332.method_51446(class_332.java)
    at com.illusivesoulworks.polymorph.api.client.widget.SelectionWidget.renderTooltip(SelectionWidget.java:119)
    
This error seems to be occurring when Polymorph is trying to render a tooltip, but containerScreen.field_2787 is returning null.

Just for the record, I previously suspected that the Almost Unified mod could be causing conflicts with Polymorph, leading to this crash. However, in this recent crash, Almost Unified was not active, so it seems to suggest that the issue lies either with Polymorph or its interaction with another mod or game element.

Any help on this would be greatly appreciated!

Thanks,

issues.title: [1.18/Forge] JEI integration is broken
issues.body:
* Polymorph: 1.18.2-0.46
* Forge/Fabric: 40.2.0

It seems that changes in JEI 10.x broke the mixin for the "transfer recipe" functionality.
I'm not that well versed in Java, but it seems that they just moved the RecipeTransferUtil class to a different namespace, so fixing should be as easy as changing line 27 of [this file](https://github.com/illusivesoulworks/polymorph/blob/1.18.x/forge/src/main/java/top/theillusivec4/polymorph/mixin/integration/jei/MixinRecipeTransferUtil.java) from 
`import mezz.jei.transfer.RecipeTransferUtil;`
to 
`import mezz.jei.common.transfer.RecipeTransferUtil;`

Relevant error log: 
>[main/WARN] [mixin/]: Error loading class: mezz/jei/transfer/RecipeTransferUtil (java.lang.ClassNotFoundException: mezz.jei.transfer.RecipeTransferUtil)
>[main/WARN] [mixin/]: Mixin target mezz.jei.transfer.RecipeTransferUtil was not found polymorph_integrations.mixins.json:jei.MixinRecipeTransferUtil

#### Observed Behavior: clicking the "move items" button of a JEI recipe can result in a conflicting recipe being selected instead
#### Expected Behavior: clicking the "move items" button from a JEI recipe automatically selects that recipe, even if there are other recipes with the same ingredients
#### Steps to Reproduce: 
1. Install JEI
2. Find a pair of conflicting recipes
3. Have the ingredients for the recipes in your inventory
4. Click the "move items" button in JEI for both recipes
5. Notice how in both cases the same recipe is selected in the crafting interface

issues.title: Crash with World Generation
issues.body:
<!--
#### Notice
Please reproduce all issues without any other unnecessary mods before submitting.
-->
#### Versions (Be specific, do not write "latest"):
* Polymorph: 1.18.1-0.39
* Forge: 1.18.1-39.1.1
#### Observed Behavior: When generating new chunks in the Nether, my Minecraft crashes, and the crash report does not seem to provide sufficient information.
#### Expected Behavior: When loading in the Nether, I expect my Minecraft to load the chunks normally without any crashes.
#### Steps to Reproduce:
1. Install all of the mods with their specified versions in the crash log. Here is a pastebin of the mods used, including Forge: https://pastebin.com/upv5QgM1
2. Start a new world.
3. Create a Nether Portal, and enter the portal.
4. After successfully entering the Nether, wait for the new chunks to load. If nothing occurs, travel around until a crash (specifically related to generation) occurs.

Crash Log: https://pastebin.com/TejfUwZG

**Additional Comments**
I have attempted to try mods individually. For example, I tested just Simple Ores, Netherrocks, SimpleCoreLib, and Polymorph. After encountering no crashes, I added TerraBlender, Biomes O' Plenty, OTBYG, Mana and Artifice, Patchouli, GeckoLib, Curios, The Graveyard, The Graveyard Biomes, and Occultism; yet, still no crash occurred. This is unusual, as removing just Polymorph or just Netherrocks from the list of mods in the mod folder solved the issue. On a separate note, please forgive me in regards to having to download many mods in recreating this crash. I fear it may be a specific conflict.

After learning about this crash, my brother had tested a new world with all of the exact same mods. However, no crash occurred on his end. This further proves my fear and how unusual this crash is.

I have already reported this to the author of TerraBlender via Discord. However, they stated the crash is not a, "TerraBlender crash," as crashes from TerraBlender provide pretty explicit logs. I was told that Polymorph could be the cause, hence why I am creating this report.


If no solution is found, yet I have an idea of what (mod) may be causing this crash, I will use this report as a reference.

issues.title: Setting default output value
issues.body:
**Please describe the new feature or change.**

This feature would introduce that you could choose which one of the recipes will show as default (in best implementation: being recognised by crafting table or smelter, even if used without GUI [injecting items by hopper]).
This way, we don't need to constantly switch between outputs, especially if we always need/prefer to craft the second/third/etc one.

**Please describe why you want this feature.**

It is - most importantly - really comfortable to have one favourite block being pushed before the random default one. So changing default blocks would make some craftings easier, and if it was also interfering with the crafting block itself without the GUI, it would also make automation way more coherent/supported.
Also, it would make [this bug](https://github.com/TheIllusiveC4/Polymorph/issues/152) a bit less annoying.

issues.title: Refined Storage Integration Deadlock on World/Server Load
issues.body:
<!--
#### Notice
Please reproduce all issues without any other unnecessary mods before submitting.
-->
#### Versions (Be specific, do not write "latest"):
* Polymorph: 1.16.5-0.36
* Forge/Fabric: Forge 1.16.5-36.2.20
#### Observed Behavior:
The Refined Storage integration causes deadlocks in certain situations due to an error during server/world loading.
#### Expected Behavior:
Servers/worlds should load normally with the Refined Storage integration active.
#### Steps to Reproduce:
Note: I am unable to reproduce this myself with the production build; however, I can force the error to arise by making some small changes to the development build. The steps below are what I have gathered from other people.
1. Place a Refined Storage Crafting Grid
2. Place a valid recipe within the crafting grid and leave it there
3. Exit and restart the world/server
4. Observe that the world/server fails to fully load and hangs until terminated

Refer also to comments in: https://github.com/TheIllusiveC4/Polymorph/issues/114

Current workaround: Go into the `configs` folder, open the `polymorph-integrations.toml` config file, and set `refinedstorage = false` to turn off all aspects of the Refined Storage integration.

issues.title: Brewing Support?
issues.body:
I am surprised no one mentioned this but will there be any support for potion recipes?  There can be various conflicts with brewing when it comes to using a single ingredient. For example, the ender pearl and eye of ender are very popular ingredients for teleportation related potions.

issues.body:

#### Versions:
* Polymorph: 1.16.4-0.19
* Forge: 1.16.4-35.1.13
#### Observed Behavior:
Attempting to use an encased fan from Create Mod [1.16.3v-0.3] 
Used with lava in order to smelt iron ore into iron ingots.
Crashed before the ore turned to ingots. Server kicks all players.
#### Expected Behavior:
Iron Ore should have smelted into iron ingots.
Smelting occurs by dropping on floor in front of an encased fan pushing air through lava.
#### Steps to Reproduce:
1. Create and power encased fan.
2. Have encased fan push air towards lava.
3. Drop a smeltable item into the particles flowing from lava.
4. Crash when server attempts to smelt.

issues.title: Conflict with latest FastWorkbench
issues.body:
Hi! I'm going to reference the issue I made here: https://github.com/Shadows-of-Fire/FastWorkbench/issues/44

I hope you will forgive me copying and pasting what I wrote there, instead of using the template:

Hello! I'm using **FastWorkbench 3.1.1** and **Polymorph 0.6** on **Forge 31.2.31**, and I'm having an issue where recipes other than the primary one don't seem to be selectable. The Polymorph icon is visible, both recipes show up in the GUI, but regardless of which one is clicked on, the output slot only ever shows the first option.

Disabling FastWorkbench allows the selection to function as intended, so I believe it is a conflict with just these two mods.

Let me know if I can get you any other information! Thanks very much!
